description: This file defines the `Route` class within the `FastRoute` namespace, representing a route with HTTP method, regex pattern, variables, and handler. It includes methods for constructing route objects and matching URLs against the route's regex pattern.

classes.name: Route
classes.description: Represents a web route with associated HTTP method, regex pattern, variables, and handler. Includes methods for route matching.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a Route instance with HTTP method, handler, regex pattern, and variables.

methods.name: matches
methods.description: Checks if a given string matches this route's regex pattern.
